stories.headline: Russian dissident Garry Kasparov says US warned him of danger to his life
stories.description: "My family and I will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power," says the former chess world champion.

stories.headline: Flydubai stabbing: How safe are planes if a pilot turns violent?
stories.description: Civil aviation changed after 9/11 to keep attackers outside cockpits. The Flydubai scare flips the dilemma.

stories.headline: UK PM Burnham says Iran likely behind RAF base incident: Is there evidence?
stories.description: UK, US and Israeli officials point to Iranian involvement but remain tight-lipped on details.

stories.headline: Blasts heard in Addis Ababa as Ethiopia conflict widens in the north
stories.description: Thousands flee Mekelle amid advancing troops and disrupted services as tensions rise in Ethiopia’s northern territories.

stories.headline: Trump's AI rebrand causes 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian website names
stories.description: The president wants AI to be called super intelligence - or SI - the same initials used by Slovenian domains.
